title: Yesu langa lomphefumlo
lyrics: Yesu, langa lomphefumlo, Akumnyama xa ukhoyo Makungabiko nany’intoEnokundahlula nawe.
Ndakuhlelwa bubuthongo, Selecima nalamehlo, Mandibe ndicinga ngawe Nangopumlo olunawe.
Hlala nam imini yonke,Ungekho andingephili,Hlala nam kwakuza ukuhlwa,Ize ndingoyik’ukufa
U’ba kukh’umntwana wakho othe wadel’izwi lakho,Z’umguqule umxolele,Az’ onwabe xa elele.
Balunguze abafayo Batyebis’abaswele Nabo bonk’ abalusiziBakhangel’ubonwabise.
Yiza kuthi sakuvuka, Usigcine yonk’imihlaSide simke emhlabeni sibe nawe eZulwini. Amen.

title: Zovakala Iindudumo
lyrics: zovakala indudumo engcwabeni; zondivusa ndisalele engcwabeni
kwakungena edlakeni ukukhanya kwemibani londibiza ixilongo mandiphume.
Ndihlangene nengelosi emafini ndiyivume apha ingoma yoloyiso. Zebabone ndinophawu lawo umnqamlezo ngcwele.

title: Bawo ndingumntwana wakho
lyrics: Bawo ndingumntwana wakho, Noko Ndonileyo, Ndiyalila phambi kwakho, Bawo ndixolele.
Iziphoso zam zininzi, Azinakubalwa, Noko ndibekise kuwe,Bawo! Ndixolele.
Imithetho ndiyaphule, Wena ndakudela, UmSindisi ndimlahlile, Bawo! Ndixolele.
Ndone ngako ukuthetha,Ndone nangeengcinga,Ndone nangemisebenzi,Bawo! Ndixolele.
Noko ndibe ndifanele Ukukubulela, Ndone ngokukulibala, Bawo! Ndixolele.
Ngaz’ izoono ezininzi, Bawo, ndizonele, Wena ndikuhlazisile, Bawo! Ndixolele.
UnguThixo onenceba Engazang’ iphele, Ngako ndiya lila, ndithi, Bawo! Ndixolele. Amen.
